title: 水去哪儿了
subtitle: 它一直在天上和地上来回跑
character: wearing a light blue t-shirt, grey shorts and sandals, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in cool watercolour style, soft transparent washes with fine blue-grey ink outlines, palette of water blue, pale teal and warm sand, plenty of clean white paper

pages.zh:
早上我在门口洒了一小片水。
中午回来看，
地上干干的，
一点水也没有了。
水去哪儿了呢？
pages.scene: The little boy crouches on a dry doorstep looking at the ground where a puddle used to be, one hand touching the dry stone.

pages.zh:
水没有不见。
它变成了看不见的「水蒸气」，
飘到空气里去了。
这件事叫蒸发，
天气越热，跑得越快。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one shallow puddle on a cream background with several small arrows rising from its surface into the air above. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水蒸气一直往上飘。
越高的地方越冷，
它被冷着了，
就重新变成很小的水珠，
小到能飘在空中。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one column of small rising arrows on a pale background turning into a cluster of tiny round droplets near the top. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
很多很多小水珠聚在一起，
就是一朵云。
云不是棉花，
它是水做的，
所以它会变形、会散开。
pages.scene: One soft white cloud on a pale blue watercolour sky on clean paper, painted simply. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
小水珠互相碰到，
会并成大水珠。
大到空气托不住了，
就掉下来——
那就是下雨。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one cloud on a pale background with small droplets joining into larger ones inside it and several larger drops falling from its underside. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
要是上面太冷，
水珠会先结成冰晶，
一层一层长大，
变成雪花落下来。
每一片都有六个角。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one six-pointed snowflake drawn large and plain on a pale blue background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
雨落到地上，
一部分顺着地面流走，
汇成小溪、汇成河；
一部分渗进土里，
藏在地下。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one hillside cross-section on a cream background with arrows showing water running down the surface into a stream and other arrows soaking down into the soil. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
河水一直往低处流，
最后流进大海。
海很大，
地球上的水，
大部分都在海里。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one earth ball on a cream background with most of its surface shaded as sea and a small part shaded as land. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
太阳照着海面，
水又变成水蒸气飘上去。
上去、下来、
流走、再上去——
水就这样一圈一圈地转。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one closed loop on a cream background: sea at the bottom left, arrows rising to a cloud at the top, rain falling to hills at the right, and a stream running back to the sea. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
海水是咸的，
可是蒸发上去的
只有水，盐留在了海里。
所以雨水是淡的，
能喝。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one sea surface on a cream background with rising arrows of clear water and small salt specks staying behind in the water. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
地球上的水，
几千万年都是这些。
我们喝的水，
很久以前
也许在别的地方下过雨。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one glass of water on a cream background with a small cloud, a small stream and a small sea drawn in a row beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我又洒了一点水在地上，
然后坐在旁边等。
水一点点变少了。
它不是消失了，
它是出发了。
pages.scene: The little boy sits on the doorstep with his chin on his hands, watching a small patch of water on the ground in the sunshine.
